name: RC-B10-0173/2024 – § 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text: Calls on the Member States to extend public bans on smoking to new and emerging products such as HTPs, e-cigarettes and other aerosol-emitting products, as appropriate, considering the available evidence of the risks posed by exposure;
